plugin.name: AI
plugin.description: Chat with Claude in the launcher through your Claude Code CLI and subscription.
command.chat.title: AI Chat
command.chat.keywords: ai, claude, chat, ask, assistant, gpt
command.history.title: AI Chat History
pref.enabled.title: Use AI
pref.enabled.description: Sends the questions you type in an AI chat to Claude through the Claude Code CLI installed on this computer, with your Claude subscription (no API key). Nothing is sent while this is off.
pref.model.title: Model
pref.webSearch.title: Allow web search
pref.webSearch.description: Lets Claude search the web and read web pages to answer.
pref.tools.title: Let AI use launcher plugins
pref.tools.description: Lets Claude search and run the launcher's plugins for you, for example to find an app, check a port or install a program. Actions that change something always ask you first. Claude gets no other access to this computer.
pref.retention.title: Keep chats for
pref.retention.description: Older chats are deleted from AI Chat History.
pref.askFallback.title: Offer “Ask AI” when nothing matches
pref.askFallback.description: When the main search finds nothing good, its last entry asks AI about what you typed. Tab always does.
fallback.title: Ask AI: {{.text}}
chat.title: AI Chat
chat.empty:
Ask {{.backend}} anything: type your question and press Enter.

Enter sends, Esc stops an answer and then goes back, Ctrl+K shows more actions.
off.heading: Chat with Claude in the launcher
off.body: golauncher can send your questions to Claude through {{.backend}}, the Claude Code CLI installed on this computer, and your Claude subscription. No API key is needed; the usage counts toward your subscription.
off.privacy: Only what you type in an AI chat is sent, and only after you turn this on. Chats stay on this computer, for 30 days by default (Settings › Plugins › AI). Press Enter to turn it on.
off.pending: Your question will be sent then:
off.placeholder: Press Enter to turn on AI
error.heading: Could not answer.
error.notInstalled: Claude Code is not installed. Install it (see https://claude.com/product/claude-code), sign in by running `claude` in a terminal, then try again.
error.notLoggedIn: Claude Code is not signed in. Run `claude` in a terminal and sign in with your Claude account, then try again.
error.version: This version of Claude Code is too old. Update it with `claude update`, then try again.
error.quota: Your Claude usage limit was reached. Claude Code says:
toast.busy: Wait for the answer, or press Esc to stop it
toast.questionCopiedHint: It is too long for a link: paste it into {{.app}}.
